name: Alaina
source: "This woman is a typical Gomorin, she likes to drink, and fight as often as she can. As a pirate she uses all her assets to get ahead, but make no mistake, as she could kill you in a heartbeat. She doesn’t hide who she is nor does she care if she doesn’t fit in. She lives her life in the moment and isn’t interested in fixing the galaxy problems, focusing on her own instead."
